after.title: Starter-Solenoid Water-Intrusion Fire Recall
after.description: NHTSA campaign 24V107 covers certain 2019 Genesis G70 vehicles. Water can enter the starter solenoid, create an electrical short, and cause an engine-compartment fire while parked or driving.
after.solution: Owners are advised to park outside and away from structures until the recall repair is complete. Check the VIN with Genesis; dealers install a remedy relay kit in the engine junction box free of charge. Heat, smoke, or burning odor requires immediate shutdown.
symptoms: Possible smoke or engine-compartment fire while parked or driving
after.contentUpdateSummary: Replaced forum-only oil-consumption, carbon, plug and engine-repair claims with the exact 2019 starter-solenoid fire recall.
